public.text: Deletion may conflict with clinical safety, legal retention, professional accountability, public-health obligations, and audit integrity.
public.suggestedRevision: Support legally appropriate erasure, restriction, masking, withdrawal from future sharing, and retention exceptions. Do not require physical deletion where law or safety requires continued retention.
